text:
jen: Heads-up — kicking off a config-only rollout now (10m change window). No model/model-code changes. Deploybot will canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% unless we hit regression thresholds.

jen: Summary of changes:
- tenant soft_limit: 1200 -> 900
- per_request timeout: 7s -> 6s
- batch.max_size: 8 -> 6
- routing policy: add latency_favor for region=NA with weight 1.15
- kv_cache.ttl: 30m -> 15m (shorter TTL to reduce stale prefix replays)

jen: Quick config snippet:```yaml
route: prod-text-gen
config:
  soft_limit: 900
  timeout_s: 6
  batch:
    max_size: 6
  routing_policy:
    preference: latency_favor
    region_weights:
      na: 1.15
  kv_cache_ttl_mins: 15
```

deploybot: @jen queued canary for thin-config-rollout tag=cfg-2026-03-23-1. Starting canary at 5% now. I will post updates at each step.

sanjay: quick Q — can we pin the route to model v2.3.1 for the canary so fallback is deterministic?

jen: yes pinned route -> model:v2.3.1 for canary only (no code change).

matt: smoke test ready: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/prod-text-gen -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status` -> expecting 200/ok. I'll run against canary nodes.

deploybot: canary 5% complete. Metrics snapshot: p99 latency +1%, error_rate 0.04% (baseline 0.05%). Advancing to 25% in 2m.

elaine: watching KV pressure metrics — if kv-cache misses spike > 30% or error_rate > 0.5% we abort. Set alert hook to rollback-channel.

ops-alerts: alert hook registered -> #deploy-rollbacks. Thresholds: errors > 0.5% OR p99 latency increase > 20% triggers paged rollback.

deploybot: 25% reached. Observability: tail latency +6% in eu-west but p50 unchanged. No errors above threshold. Advancing to 100% (staged ramp in 5m).

sanjay: can we soft-throttle tenant heavy-emit-42 to 10% traffic for next 2h? They contribute a lot of tail.

jen: doing tenant exclude for heavy-emit-42 -> set tenant_override: 10% via routing policy. Patch applied.

deploybot: rollout to 100% complete; config applied cluster-wide at 1738409400. Release note draft: "Config-only: soft_limits, timeouts, batch tuning, routing weight, kv_cache ttl. Canary observed slight tail latency bumps in eu-west; tenant heavy-emit-42 limited to 10% for stabilization." Link: https://confluence/redwood/changes/cfg-2026-03-23-1

matt: changelog updated and tagged `thin-config-2026-03-23`. Added observability query and baseline compare.

elaine: monitoring for 30m. Rollback plan standby: revert to snapshot cfg-2026-03-22-9 if errors > 0.8% or sustained p99 > baseline+40% for 10m.

deploybot: If anyone requests an immediate rollback, post `rollback cfg-2026-03-22-9` in this thread and I'll execute dry-unwind + notification.

sanjay: noted. Thanks team.

jen: excellent. I'll keep this thread open for the 30m watch. Ping me @jen if you see anything actionable. :eyes:

ops-alerts: no paged alerts yet. Will update if thresholds crossed. :white_check_mark:
